title: Novaite Origins
description: Novaite is a vanilla-friendly Minecraft 1.21.8 Fabric mod that adds a brand-new ore to the Overworld.
body:
> **Novaite** is a vanilla-friendly Minecraft 1.21.8 Fabric mod that adds a brand-new ore to the Overworld. Mine **Raw Novaite**, smelt it into **Novaite Ingots**, and craft a complete set of powerful tools and armor.

> Features
Adds **Novaite Ore** to the Overworld.
Includes both **Stone** and **Deepslate Novaite Ore variants.**
Introduces **Raw Novaite** and **Novaite Ingots**.
Adds a full set of **Novaite tools.**
Adds a full set of **Novaite armor.**
Designed to fit naturally into vanilla Minecraft progression.

> _Requirements_
- Minecraft 1.21.8
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API (required)
  
> Compatibility
- Shader packs that add ore glow or emissive ore effects are not compatible with Novaite Ore. The ore will function normally, but it will not receive the shader's glowing effect.

Thank you for downloading Novaite! More content and features may be added in future updates.
